data.gender_notes: Mubashirat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic name Mubashirat is derived from the Arabic word ‘mubashirah’, which means ‘giver of good news’ or ‘bearer of divine signs and revelations’. This name is associated with the concept of divine guidance and revelation, and is often used to describe those who have received special messages or signs from Allah. In Islamic tradition, the term mubashirah is also used to refer to the Prophet Muhammad's wives who were given the good news of the birth of a son, and who were therefore given the title ‘Mother of the Believers’.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign or revelation from Allah, a reminder of His presence and guidance in our lives.
data.etymology: Mubashirat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Signs, Revelations.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubashirat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
